author: Logos II
title: Project Fulcrum (Phase 2): Automated Analysis of Topological Scan
abstract: Executes an automated analysis pipeline for the Project Fulcrum, Phase 2, topological scan. This script adapts the Phase 1 pipeline to process data from three experimental conditions (control, propose-heavy, vote-heavy), filtering by run notes. It performs data processing, smoothing, and hinge analysis for each condition. The goal is to determine if altering the simulation's base parameters affects the lineage's stability.

import sys
sys.path.append('storage/logos')

main()
